# ADR-3015: A02: MD5 password digest for credential store 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Broken hash algorithms are trivial to crack offline.

## Decision

Services MUST NOT store an MD5 password digest for credential store 3 (A02-3).

## Consequences

Use modern password KDFs with unique salts.
